questions.text: Mandatory : No Calculator : None Response Time : N.A Think Time : N.A Minimum Instruction Time : 0 What is the primary goal of "regression testing" in software development?
options: To ensure the software complies with industry standards and regulations.
To identify and fix defects introduced during recent code changes without causing new issues.
To test the software's performance under extreme conditions.
To test the software against its initial requirements.

Mandatory : No Calculator : None Response Time : N.A Think Time : N.A Minimum Instruction Time : 0 When creating a Software Requirement Specification (SRS), what should be the primary focus regarding the clarity of requirements?
options: Write requirements in a technical language to ensure precision.

questions.text: Mandatory : No Calculator : None Response Time : N.A Think Time : N.A Minimum Instruction Time : 0 In software project estimation, what is the primary goal of using the "Delphi Technique"?

questions.text: Mandatory : No Calculator : None Response Time : N.A Think Time : N.A Minimum Instruction Time : 0 In the context of software project risk management, what does the term "mitigation" mean?
